description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {R}{G} and untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
